Name: Inflict Terror
Description: You whisper a discordant, threatening phrase that only one creature you choose within range can hear, filling them with dread. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they take 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use their reaction (if available) to move as far as their speed allows away from you. The creature doesn’t move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn’t have to move away. A deafened creature automatically succeeds on the save.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 1st:
• The spell deals an additional 1d6 of damage.
• (2 slot levels) You may choose one additional target within range.
• (2 slot levels) If a target fails their save, they are frightened of you until the end of your following turn. While frightened, they must use their action to Dash and get as far away from you as possible. If they cannot move further away or their only choice is to move toward you, they take the Dodge action instead.
